name: design-system-kit
description: Universal design system and visual QA for any product UI: Android (Compose + Haze 2.1), iOS (SwiftUI + Liquid Glass) and web (CSS/React/Tailwind). Owner standards, project profile (/ds-init), anti-slop taste rules, tokens, glass, accessibility, real-vision review (/ds-visual-audit), auto-detected verify gate (/ds-verify), locale-parity hook for Android XML and JSON messages.
